title: 10/10 Sci-Fi Classic Anime Reboot Drops New Trailer Ahead of July Premiere
content: Ghost in the Shell is coming back to screens with a whole new anime reboot this Summer, and fans have gotten a new look at what to expect with a fresh trailer ahead of its premiere this July.
author: ComicBook

title: My Adventures with Superman Reveals First Look at New Green Lantern (& Cast Disney Princess for Spinoff)
content: My Adventures with Superman is now working its way through Season 3 of the animated series, and has dropped the first look at a new Green Lantern ahead of their debut in the next episode.
author: ComicBook

title: School of Horns' Mito Aoi Launches New Manga
content: Manga creators Mito Aoi and Meza Tōno launched a new manga titled Koko ni Fukuen Flag ga Tatteimasu ( Here is the flag of reconciliation. ) in Kodansha 's Comic Days app on June 6. Tōno is writing the story, and Aoi is drawing the art.
author: ANN

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film's Trailer Previews Song by Tōko Kirishima
content: The official website for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ) film, the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream ( Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, began streaming the film's main trailer on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Witch Hat Atelier Fifth Story Visual Highlights Richeh
content: The fifth and latest story visual of Witch Hat Atelier anime highlights Richeh, who was one of the main focuses in Episode 12. Agott and Euini also appear on the visual. The anime is currently ongoing with 12 episodes and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Major Boruto Character Upgrade Teased in New Two Blue Vortex Chapter 35 Preview
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 35 is set to be the next installment of the manga and is only a few days away from release. Ahead of its arrival, a preview has been teased, and while it doesn’t confirm anything, it may have hinted at a training arc for a major Boruto character, which would be a natural development…
author: ComicBook

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Movie Reveals Main Trailer
content: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend movie revealed a main trailer on Monday. It is set to premiere in Japanese theaters on October 16. The upcoming movie is a sequel to Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus, which concluded in September 2025. CloverWorks returns to animate the conclusion to the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ameku M.D.'s Mikito Chinen Launches New Manga
content: Mikito Chinen launched a new series with artist Kiyo Hasui on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker platform titled Prometheus Taisen (Prometheus War) on Wednesday. The story is set in the year 2045, after a calamity has struck humanity.
author: ANN

title: Jun Nishikawa's Maken no Deshi wa Munō de Saikyō! Manga Adaptation Ends
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform published the final chapter of Jun Nishikawa 's manga adaptation of Sametarō Fukada 's Maken no Deshi wa Munō de Saikyō! Eiyū-ryū no Shugyō de Bannō ni Naretanode, Saikyō o Mezashimasu (The Demon Sword Disciple is Incompetent and the Strongest!
author: ANN

title: SuBLime Licenses 2 New Manga for Physical, Digital Release
content: Viz Media 's SuBLime imprint for boys-love manga announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday that it has licensed Mayuharu's Bursting with Love manga, and Fumi Tsuyuhisa 's Palace of the Omega: A Snowflower's Tale manga for English digital and physical release in early 2027.
author: ANN
